title: Properties and applications of Muckenhoupt $A_1$ growth weights
summary: For $β\ge0$, let $A_1^{(β)}$ be the class of weights satisfying $$ [w]_{A_1^{(β)}}:= \sup_{0 1}A_p$ for $β>0$. For every $α\ge0$, we prove that $w\in A_1^{(β)}$ if and only if $$ w\left(\left\{M_{L(\log L)^α}f>λ\right\}\right) \le C\int_{\mathbb{R}^n} \frac{|f(x)|}λ \left[ \log\left(e+\frac{|f(x)|}λ\right) \right]^{α+β} w(x)\,\mathrm{d}x. $$ The least constant $C$ is comparable to $[w]_{A_1^{(β)}}$. Also, we obtain corresponding characterizations for Calderón--Zygmund operators and their commutators.
